navigation.archive_path: www.law.upenn.edu/journals/{code} (brochure) -> scholarship.law.upenn.edu/{code} (301) -> repository.law.upenn.edu/{collection}/{code} (JS document list) -> /Documents/Detail/{slug}/{id} -> full-article PDF via frontend-api download/init
navigation.pagination: none - start_urls are enumerated Detail URLs; the Quartex listing is Knockout.js and exposes no links in server HTML
navigation.notes: law.upenn.edu/journals/{jbl,jlasc,jil,alr} are brochure pages with NO articles; the 'View Archives' link goes to scholarship.law.upenn.edu/{slug} which 301s to repository.law.upenn.edu (AM Quartex, client key 'pcl'). Listing pages are Knockout.js + infinite scroll: server HTML contains no article links, so discovery needs headless rendering. The listing page DOES embed settings.controlledVocabs (full Volumes/Issues facet with per-facet document counts) and settings.categoryValue (the collection name) in inline JS - a reliable way to enumerate volumes/issues without rendering. Article detail pages are /Documents/Detail/{slug}/{id} (or /Documents/Detail/{id}); they embed var viewerItems = [...] with one entry per page image, each carrying a per-page pdfUrl (https://images.quartexcollections.com/pcl/PDFs/GetPDF/{asset}/{parent}/?jwt=[IMAGETOKEN]) where [IMAGETOKEN] is substituted from the same JSON's imageToken. FULL-ARTICLE PDF (preferred): GET https://frontend-api.quartexcollections.com/v1/pcl/download/{docId}/pdf/init?create=true with header 'Authorization: Bearer <downloadToken from detail page JS>' returns {pdfGenerationStatus, encodedImageToken, downloadUrl}; then GET {downloadUrl}?jwt={encodedImageToken} returns the whole article as one PDF (verified: 28 J. Bus. L. 1 (2026) -> jblv28i1n1.pdf, 989,686 bytes, 48pp). Fully open access - no login, no paywall; tokens are handed out anonymously by the page. Asset paths encode the journal+volume+issue+article (e.g. jblv28i1n1 = JBL v28 i1 art1), which is a clean way to attribute documents to a journal. Site-wide sitemap: https://repository.law.upenn.edu/sitemap.xml -> /sitemap_urls?type=DOCUMENT&skip=0&take=10000 (17,517 document detail URLs total, all 8 PCL journals combined; NOT journal-scoped). The internal list API POST https://frontend-api.quartexcollections.com/v1/pcl/document/getdocumentlist (Bearer settings.websiteToken) exists but returned HTTP 500 for every payload shape tried - use headless rendering or the sitemap+asset-path filter instead. robots.txt (repository.law.upenn.edu): only 'Disallow: /login' and 'Disallow: /cms/*'; no Crawl-delay. robots.txt (www.law.upenn.edu): long Disallow list, none covering /journals/*; no Crawl-delay. www.law.upenn.edu sits behind CloudFront and returns HTTP 403 to non-browser User-Agents - send a full desktop browser UA + Accept/Accept-Language headers. SMOKE TEST 2026-08-29: seeding the collection list URL through QuartexAdapter gives 'no PDF candidates discovered (discovered=0)' for all four journals - the server HTML has zero /Documents/Detail/ links, and playwright is not installed in this environment so --playwright-headless was a no-op. Seeding a DETAIL url instead PASSES: https://repository.law.upenn.edu/Documents/Detail/588607 -> QuartexAdapter (method=requests) -> jblv28i1n1.pdf, 989,686 bytes. So the DOWNLOAD path in QuartexAdapter already works end-to-end; the only gap is DISCOVERY of detail URLs from a JS-rendered list page. Two fixes, either is sufficient: (a) install playwright and render the list with infinite-scroll; (b) enumerate /sitemap_urls?type=DOCUMENT (17,517 URLs covering all 8 PCL journals) and attribute each doc to a journal by its viewerItems asset path prefix (jbl/jil/alr/jlasc) or its 'Preferred Citation' metadata field. DOI enumeration was tested and does NOT work as a shortcut: 10.58112/{code}.{vol}-{iss}.{n} resolves only for the most recent volumes (jbl.28-1.1 OK; jbl.20-1.1, jil.10-1.1, alr.05-1.1, jlasc.15-1.1 all 404 at doi.org).
